title: Mariana Becker and the Hamilton Controversy
seoTitle: Mariana Becker and Hamilton Controversy in F1
subtitle: Journalist criticizes Lewis Hamilton, sparking debate among fans
excerpt: Globo commentator Mariana Becker claimed Lewis Hamilton hindered Gabriel Bortoleto at the Spanish GP, drawing criticism from fans who dispute the incident.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
During the Spanish GP broadcast, journalist Mariana Becker, who works as an on-site commentator for Globo, raised an accusation that quickly spread across social media. At the end of Gabriel Bortoleto's lap, the Brazilian stated that Lewis Hamilton seemed to have hindered the Audi driver. The statement sparked controversy, as fans disputed the journalist's interpretation, claiming the incident never even occurred.

Mariana Becker and Globo's Broadcast

Mariana Becker began working as an on-site commentator for Globo. Her role is to comment on races, practices, and qualifying sessions directly from the event locations. In the 2026 F1 season, she will be present at 15 stages broadcast by the network, in addition to six other races shown on SporTV.

Fans' Reaction to the Comment

Mariana Becker's comment gained traction because Bortoleto did not report any issues involving Hamilton over the radio while returning to the pits. The Brazilian also did not attribute his elimination to interference from the Ferrari driver and, according to his own assessment, the result occurred because he couldn't complete a good lap.

Narration and Commentary Teams at Globo and SporTV

At Globo, the team includes Everaldo Marques for narration and Luciano Burti for commentary. On SporTV, Bruno Fonseca will be the narrator and will share the booth with various commentators throughout the championship, including Felipe Giaffone, Christian Fittipaldi, and Rafael Lopes. Reporters Marcelo Courrege, Julia Guimarães, and Guilherme Pereira also cover the calendar stages.

Impact on Public Perception

Mariana Becker's comment and the fans' dispute demonstrate how the interpretation of a remark can quickly become a subject of debate on digital platforms, reflecting the sensitivity of fans regarding statements made by sports journalists.

With information from LANCE!, F1Mania.net.
